import React from 'react'
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import App_blank from './App'
import './index.css'

const root_blank = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root_blank'))
root_blank.render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <BrowserRouter>
      <App_blank />
    </BrowserRouter>
  </React.StrictMode>
)
